description: Source code for the 'protobuf' package implementing protobuf serialization for Kubernetes code generation, including package configuration, filtering, and code generation functions.

classes.name: protobufPackage
classes.description: Struct implementing protobuf serialization configuration and code generation for a specific package.

methods.name: newProtobufPackage
methods.description: Constructor for protobufPackage, initializes package configuration.

methods.name: Clean
methods.description: Removes generated files for the package.

methods.name: ProtoTypeName
methods.description: Returns the protobuf type name representation.

methods.name: filterFunc
methods.description: Determines if a type should be included for protobuf generation based on its kind and attributes.

methods.name: HasGoType
methods.description: Checks if a given Go type name is exported by the package.

methods.name: OptionalTypeName
methods.description: Checks if a given type name is marked as optional for protobuf.

methods.name: ExtractGeneratedType
methods.description: Extracts protobuf-related struct tags from a Go type specification.

methods.name: generatorsFunc
methods.description: Generates code generators for protobuf serialization.

methods.name: GoPackageName
methods.description: Returns the Go package name derived from the package path.

methods.name: ImportPath
methods.description: Returns the import path for the generated protobuf files.

methods.name: OutputPath
methods.description: Returns the output path for the generated Go protobuf code.
